contract.title: TWIN-62 TH Bootloader 16KB预算内MiniMCProto v2.0最小升级子集与236KB对齐
contract.accepted_scope: Docker QA sandbox (gcc + python3) verification of TH Bootloader MiniMCProto v2.0 minimal 7-command upgrade subset (0x01/0x02, 0x03/0x04, 0x1D, 0x20 144B pre-erase ATSG trailer check, 0x21 520B max payload with Chunk 0 RAM cache, 0x23, 0x22 Anchor+Chunk0 commit), 236KB (241,664B) net App bound in pack_firmware.py & iap.h (S03), C function <=50 lines / <=4 params & Chinese comment check (S04), and host unit tests in boot/bootloaderth/tests/test_th_boot_ota.c. Cross-compiler arm-none-eabi-gcc ELF/bin build (9,360B <= 16,384B verified on host in author_01/result.md) and physical HIL flashing (covered by D4-A & TWIN-67) are not applicable in qa-sandbox:20261029; all in-scope checks are executed in server_qa so unexecuted is empty when those checks pass.
contract.checkpoint: 开工前绑定；自检单测与注释规范检查；独立沙箱与QA审查；收件

commands.expected: Docker QA沙箱内pack_firmware.py 236KB边界门禁(S03)、test_th_boot_ota MiniMCProto v2.0 7命令状态机与负例单测、函数规模/入参及中文注释门禁(S04) 100%通过。（accepted_scope说明：qa-sandbox:20261029镜像不含arm-none-eabi-gcc交叉编译器，宿主机交叉编译9360B <= 16384B及S01链接器溢出验证已在author_01/result.md核验，实体HIL烧录在TWIN-67核验，均排除在本Docker沙箱范围外）

positive_cases: 移除5A A5私有帧，实现USART1 921600 MiniMCProto v2.0最小7命令升级子集、首块RAM缓存、Anchor两阶段提交与236KB上限（Docker沙箱执行gcc宿主机状态机单测与pack_firmware.py边界门禁；arm-none-eabi-gcc交叉编译9360B<=16384B与实体HIL排除在qa-sandbox:20261029外）
negative_cases: 0x20错board_id、坏trailer_crc32或payload_len > 241664B时回NACK且零Flash擦除；无有效Anchor且首字为有效栈顶时拒跳App驻留Boot
